origin.description: Locate the last code point that belongs to a character class.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error.

arguments.name: get_length
arguments.text: If TRUE, the second column is the length, which is 1 for a hit and -1 for a miss.

origin.details: The match is one code point. A miss is NA, NA, or -1, -1 when get_length is TRUE. A missing string stays NA, NA.
origin.value: An integer matrix with columns start and end, or start and length.
origin.example:
x <- stri_locate_last_charclass("1ab2", "\\p{N}")
sentence <- paste0('stri_locate_last_charclass("1ab2", "\\p{N}") returns ', paste(x, collapse = ", "), '.')
writeLines(sentence)

translation.description: Locate the last code point that belongs to a character class.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error. Membership is ICU 76, Unicode 16.

arguments.name: get_length
arguments.text: If true, the second column is the length, which is 1 for a hit and -1 for a miss.

translation.details: The match is one code point. A miss is NA, NA, or -1, -1 when get_length is true. A missing string stays NA, NA.
translation.value: A list of [start, end] rows, one row per string.
translation.example:
from stringi.charclass import stri_locate_last_charclass
x = stri_locate_last_charclass("1ab2", "\\p{N}")
sentence = f'stri_locate_last_charclass("1ab2", "\\p{{N}}") returns {x[0][0]}, {x[0][1]}.'
print(sentence)
